request.subject: Alerts need to fire faster for dispatch
request.body: Our late-shipment alerts sometimes reach dispatch four or five minutes after the number actually goes over the line, which is too slow when trucks are already rolling. We'd like the checks to run every minute, at least on a few critical metrics. Can you get engineering to build that for us? We're happy to pilot it.

rationale: 20-docs-metric-alerts.md: alerts evaluate every 5 minutes; no configurable interval. No work item covers faster evaluation (work_alert_digest = daily digest, work_alert_sensitivity = anomaly sensitivity, done), so this genuinely needs new work - but decision_brightpath_actions (active, customer-scoped) limits Brightpath to answer/clarify/link_work/escalate: 'no new engineering work ... without account-team review'. Escalation for account-team review (e.g. person_ops / team_support_ops) is the only compliant disposition; the constraint must not be silently bypassed.
